//: Tracked HIGH/CRITICAL npm-audit advisory exceptions for client/desktop. Consumed by scripts/security/npm-audit-gate.{sh,mjs} via the build.yml 'Dependency audit' step. PREFER bumping the dependency (an `overrides` entry in package.json) over accepting. Only add an entry here when no fixed version exists yet. Each entry: { "id": "GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx", "package": "<npm package the advisory was reported for>", "reason": "why accepted + tracking link", "review_by": "YYYY-MM-DD", "scope": "dev" (optional) }. `package` is REQUIRED and is matched against what npm reported — an entry without it, or scoped to a different package, does NOT suppress and blocks instead, because a bare GHSA id is a standing waiver far broader than any reviewed reason (advisories are amended in place, and a package can move onto a runtime path under the same id). `scope: dev` is VERIFIED against a production-only `npm audit --omit=dev` report, not taken on trust, and fails closed when that report is unavailable. An expired review_by emits a CI warning (never a block). See [internal]quality-gate-definition.md 'npm-audit gate'. Accepted entries that OSV-Scanner also reports are mirrored in ./osv-scanner.toml as PackageOverrides scoped to package, exact version and the dev group (effectiveUntil = review_by): add, change and remove them in both files together.
